answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21425 Country: India Title: Plz tell me that Can a muslim works in a bank as an employee? Question: Assalam Alaikum, Plz tell me that Can a muslim works in a bank as an employee? Answer ID: 21425 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 544/544/M=1431) It is unlawful for a Muslim to do job in a bank where he has to record interest, calculate it and bear witness to it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
